title_zh: 健康气流与风水叙事的现场观测及模型校准协议
purpose: 把风、污染、热、遮阴、蓝绿可达和水风险的后续现场工作预注册为可复核的数据包；本文件不包含海淀现场数值，不把文化叙事变成健康或工程结论。

cultural_boundary.permitted_use: 空间记忆、景观叙事和公众感知访谈中的文化词汇
prohibited_inference: 空气质量、污染稀释或通风廊道证明
水文规律、排水能力或工程安全结论
审批、实施或专业责任替代
cultural_boundary.reporting_rule: 任何结果必须分开报告风舒适、污染滞留、热暴露、遮阴、蓝绿可达和水风险；不得生成风水健康总分。

study_design.geometry_rule: 先锁定版本化的官方或测绘几何；临时几何只能用于方法演练，不能用于正式面积、审批或健康结论。

strata.purpose: 捕捉开敞边界、节点和树冠/廊架改变后的行人层风热条件

strata.coverage: each representative canyon or enclosed public-space edge
strata.purpose: 成对记录迎风侧、背风侧、街谷中心和上游背景，避免只测一个看起来舒服的点

strata.coverage: representative connecting routes and the weakest accessible segment
strata.purpose: 把风热、遮阴、蓝绿入口和回退路线绑定到实际可走的路径，而不是只与面状图层相交

strata.coverage: traffic, construction, event and service-activity interfaces when present
strata.purpose: 记录排放源、活动时序和背景浓度，避免把污染热点归因于风向或风水叙事

point_rules.secondary_heights: The responsible wind/thermal professional must pre-register any additional heights needed for seated users, children, trees, screens or source attribution.
point_rules.same_point_rule: Every field point receives a stable point_id and geometry_version; the CFD or dispersion output must be sampled at the same point definition and reported tolerance.
point_rules.route_rule: A route result is valid only when entrances, slope, surface, shade duration, rest/cooling points, closures and fallback routing are field verified.

session_matrix.condition: Each season's pre-registered prevailing-wind cases from a lawful, versioned meteorological input.
session_matrix.field_action: Measure wind speed/direction, air temperature, relative humidity, globe temperature or equivalent MRT inputs, and PM2.5 where an emission source is in scope.

session_matrix.condition: A low-wind or calm sensitivity case defined before the campaign.
session_matrix.field_action: Keep pollutant and heat interpretations separate; do not infer stagnation from a single still-air snapshot.

session_matrix.condition: Leaf-on and leaf-off canopy states where tree drag, shade or visibility affects the model.
session_matrix.field_action: Record canopy state, crown geometry version and maintenance/closure conditions.

session_matrix.condition: A professionally approved sensitivity model for strong wind, heat or storm exceedance; field teams do not sample during unsafe conditions.
session_matrix.field_action: Activate stop/closure rules and use a human fallback route; a simulated sensitivity case is not a measured event.

study_design.sample_size_rule: The professional team must pre-register point count, repeat count, session duration and stratification before deployment, based on the final geometry and safety plan. The submission does not invent a sample size or call a convenience walk representative.

instrument_classes.rule: Use a calibrated anemometer or equivalent professional instrument; collocate mobile units with a reference before and after each campaign and preserve the raw series.
A PM2.5 reading is not a source attribution. Record instrument checks, background station, source schedule and missing periods before counting a hotspot.
Instrument characteristics and measurement method must be reviewed against the applicable thermal-environment standard; tree count is not an MRT measurement.

time_and_location.raw_sampling: Pre-register raw sampling interval and aggregation window; preserve both raw and derived records.
time_and_location.time_standard: Use Asia/Shanghai for public reports and an unambiguous ISO 8601 timestamp with offset in raw records.
time_and_location.clock_rule: Synchronize clocks before each session and record clock drift in the calibration log.
time_and_location.location_rule: Record point_id, latitude, longitude, elevation/height, route segment, geometry_version and obstruction/canopy notes.

instrument_and_data_contract.privacy_rule: Store no facial image, individual trajectory or health diagnosis; public release uses point/route aggregates and keeps raw records under the responsible data-governance process.

pre_registration: geometry version, domain size, surface and canopy representation
inflow profile, wind-direction cases, turbulence/dispersion model and solver settings
emission inventory, background concentration and activity schedule where AIR-02 applies
comfort, stagnation, thermal and water thresholds with responsible reviewer and version

comparison.rule: Compare model and field data only at the same point_id, geometry_version and declared time/wind case.
comparison.acceptance_thresholds: Set and sign off thresholds before seeing the result; never choose a threshold after the model has failed calibration.
comparison.reporting: Publish raw-data manifest, calibration record, model configuration, comparison table, uncertainty and limitations together.

model_alignment_and_qc.known_transition: A metric may move from unknown only when its gate-specific evidence, field/model comparison, exclusions, uncertainty and named professional acceptance are all present.

stop_conditions.trigger: geometry_version is missing, provisional geometry is being used for a formal claim, or model and field points cannot be aligned
stop_conditions.action: stop interpretation; keep every affected metric unknown and repair the geometry package

stop_conditions.trigger: calibration/collocation record is absent, expired, or outside the pre-registered quality rule
stop_conditions.action: discard the affected comparison; do not convert a raw reading into a baseline

stop_conditions.trigger: unsafe wind, heat, lightning, flooding, traffic or crowd condition
stop_conditions.action: stop the field session, close or reroute the public path, and activate the human fallback

stop_conditions.trigger: pollution source activity, background concentration or detection limit is missing
stop_conditions.action: do not count a pollutant hotspot or claim source attribution

stop_conditions.trigger: a result relies on proximity, visual greenery, '藏风聚气' or '风水' language instead of a gate-specific observation
stop_conditions.action: remove the causal wording and retain the metric as unknown

stop_conditions.trigger: a route blocks an accessible user, cannot be manually rerouted, or has a water-depth/velocity exceedance without a safe alternative
stop_conditions.action: pause the pilot and publish the closure, warning and non-digital fallback

release_artifacts: raw-data manifest and field observation files
professional sign-off and public limitations note
